text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's early February, and I'm out shopping with Winning Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I got towels, I got sports drinks… Warm compresses, cold spray—all good!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I think I got all the stuff I need for training. I'm gonna keep running all I can this month!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: No need to thank me! I'm the one using this stuff, after all.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Besides, I was just thinking I gotta go shopping.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh… Ingredients for homemade chocolates!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It's almost Valentine's Day, right? I promised my friends we'd give each other chocolates!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: And of course I'm giving you some too! You're gonna love it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On Valentine's Day…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems like most students are having a great time today, but…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hmmm… This is so weird…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Remember I told you how me and my friends promised to give each other chocolates?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: But it's so weird. On my way to practice just now, they gave me some outta nowhere…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Why now? Why today? Is Valentine's Eve a thing?
choice_data_list: So you didn't give your friends anything?
So you didn't give your friends anything?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Well, no. I mean, Valentine's Day is tomorrow, right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: NO WAAAY! I got the day wrong!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That's why everyone gave me those weird looks when I didn't give them anything in return!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Couldn't they have at least reminded me that Valentine's Day is today? Waaaah!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sniff… I'll apologize and give them their chocolates tomorrow. I'll bring yours tomorrow too, okay, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Winning Ticket ends up celebrating Valentine's Day one day late.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No matter how long I wait, Winning Ticket isn't showing up for training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When I ask her classmates, they say she hurried back to the dorm, so I go to take a look.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry, Trainer! I forgot to tell you I'd be late!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Actually, this morning, I got some chocolates from my fans.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: So that's when I remembered Valentine's Day is today!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: If it weren't for those fans, I probably would've made it all the way to practice without even noticing!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Aww, thanks, fans! You're the b-best! Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: …Anyway, I figured if I hurry, I can still get some chocolates ready in time, so I'm making them right now.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: But I don't think I can make them and get to training on time…
choice_data_list: That's okay—you do what you gotta do!
That's okay—you do what you gotta do!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Aww, Trainer! Thank youuuu!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All right, I gotta roll up my sleeves and make some chocolates that'll put a smile on everyone's face!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'll make some for you too, so get ready for something good!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After she's done, Winning Ticket brings her chocolates to training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She wrapped them before the chocolate cooled, so the shapes are a little strange, but they're lovingly made and delicious, all the same.
